categories.label: Spreadsheet work
categories.evidenceSummary: Three entries explicitly report incorrect totals, broken formulas, duplicated totals, or incorrect cell references; a fourth requests a pivot table and verification.

categories.label: Writing
categories.evidenceSummary: Four writing requests without explicit friction. A request for a stronger headline alone does not establish a prior failure. No completed writing outcomes are supplied.

surprising: Routine spreadsheet correctness is the clearest weakness: three of four relevant entries explicitly report errors involving formulas, totals, or cell references.

recommended.reason: Supports formula, reference, and total validation across spreadsheet tasks.

headline: Writing: Covered. Spreadsheet work: Critical.
scope: Results describe the supplied sample, not the model’s intelligence. Prompts do not establish successful execution or attribute reported defects to a particular agent.

methodology.coverageMeaning: Covered means represented without explicit friction in this sample; it does not establish competence or successful outcomes.
methodology.strengthBasis: Writing is the strongest measured category under the sample rubric because it has no explicit friction, whereas the other measured category has repeated explicit friction. Task frequency alone is not evidence of strength.
methodology.criticalRule: At least three relevant entries, at least two with explicit friction, and a friction rate of at least half.
methodology.recommendationsMeaning: Relevant to the observed gap, not confirmed missing installations.
